Maria Chen: Quick follow-up from today's security all-hands. Dropping live Qs here so we can assign owners.
Sanjay Patel: BYOK for Private VPCs 1 target timeline?
Alex Rivera: Audit log retention options and export SLAs needed for sales one-pager.
Jess Liu: ISO vs SOC2 question 1 are we reusing artifacts or running separate assessments?
Sanjay Patel: Short plan: Private BYOK target Q3 (customer KMS). Hosted BYOK needs HSM/policy work, target Q4, gated by security/legal.
Tyler Nguyen: Proposed retention tiers: default 90d; enterprise up to 7y with S3/GCS export connectors. Export SLA: standard 24h, expedited 4h (pre-approved).
Cory Brooks: Legal/privacy flag: EU PII exports require privacy review and redaction rules before promises.
Alex Rivera: Draft export record example (JSONL single-line): {"ts":"2026-03-23T18:00:00Z","req_id":"req_abc123","actor":"svc:acme","route":"/v1/generate","model":"redwood/gpt-13b","tokens_in":42,"tokens_out":210,"outcome":"success","kms_key_id":"projects/foo/locations/global/keyRings/r1/cryptoKeys/k1"}
Jess Liu: ISO will reuse SOC2 where possible but add supplier assessments; I'll produce a gap matrix.
Sanjay Patel: Key rotation plan: KMS rotates, runtime supports rewrap at lease boundaries so rotations are online; integration tests needed.
legal-bot: Reminder: please open a privacy review ticket before committing cross-border export SLAs.
Maria Chen: Action items: 1) @Sanjay publish BYOK gating checklist (EOD Tue). 2) @Alex draft audit-export schema + retention/pricing. 3) @Jess deliver ISO gap matrix (by Fri). 4) @Tyler draft SLA/KPI messaging. Loop in Legal/Privacy before customer-facing statements.
Alex Rivera: Will push docs PR and tag security/privacy.
Sanjay Patel: Scheduling ops sync to review gating items and runtime tests.
Jess Liu: Coordinating vendor assessment templates with VendorOps.
Maria Chen: Thanks everyone 1 keep updates here and ping if blockers appear. :thumbsup:
